title: Cadiveu Professional: The Complete Guide for European Salons
seo_title: Cadiveu Professional UK & EU — Complete Guide | Brazilian Beauty Index
seo_description: Everything European salons and distributors need to know about Cadiveu Professional — product lines, CPNP compliance and how to stock it.
excerpt: Since 1997, Cadiveu has been setting the standard for Brazilian professional hair care. Here's everything distributors and salon owners need to know.
author: BBI Editorial
content:
Why Cadiveu?

Since 1997, Cadiveu has been setting the standard for Brazilian professional hair care. With a portfolio spanning keratin treatments, hair botox and daily care systems, the brand has built an unrivalled reputation in over 60 countries.

For European salons and distributors, Cadiveu represents a proven commercial opportunity — clients recognise the name, stylists trust the results, and the brand's compliance-ready formulations make EU and UK market entry straightforward.

Key Product Lines

Brasil Cacau

The brand's signature keratin treatment line. Brasil Cacau uses cacao extract and keratin proteins to smooth, strengthen and hydrate. A single treatment typically lasts 3–5 months.

Plástica dos Fios

Often described as a hair botox, Plástica dos Fios is a deep conditioning and fibre restoration treatment. It rebuilds the hair's structure from within, delivering visible transformation in a single session.

Regulatory Status in the EU & UK

All Cadiveu products distributed through authorised channels are CPNP-notified for the EU market and compliant with UK cosmetics regulations post-Brexit. Safety data sheets and certificates of analysis are available on request.

title: Açaí in Beauty: Why the Amazon Superfruit Is Reshaping Skincare
seo_title: Açaí Beauty Benefits — Skincare, Hair Care & More | Brazilian Beauty Index
seo_description: Açaí is moving from smoothie bowls to premium serums. Why this Amazon superfruit is the skincare ingredient every formulator wants.
excerpt: From smoothie bowls to high-end serums — how Brazil's most famous fruit became a global beauty staple.
author: BBI Editorial
content:
The Antioxidant Case for Açaí

Açaí berries carry one of the highest ORAC scores ever recorded for a natural ingredient — roughly 10 times the antioxidant capacity of blueberries. In beauty terms, that translates to protection against free radical damage, UV stress and environmental aggressors.

The berry's deep purple colour comes from anthocyanins. Same compounds that make red wine a dinner-party talking point. But unlike red wine, there's no hangover — just a potent cocktail of oleic acid, phytosterols and vitamins A, C and E that cosmetic chemists genuinely get excited about.

Where It Works in Formulation

The fatty acid profile of açaí oil — roughly 60% oleic acid — makes it an excellent emollient for moisturisers and serums. It penetrates the lipid barrier without leaving a greasy film. For hair, it adds slip to conditioners and enhances shine in leave-in treatments.

Brazilian Brands Leading the Way

Several Brazilian professional hair care brands have incorporated açaí into their formulations. Look for it in treatment masks and leave-in serums where it pairs well with keratin proteins for a synergistic smoothing effect.

title: Importing Brazilian Cosmetics to the EU: The CPNP Checklist
seo_title: CPNP Notification for Brazilian Cosmetics — Import Guide 2026 | Brazilian Beauty Index
seo_description: Step-by-step guide to importing Brazilian hair care and beauty products into the EU. CPNP notification, safety reports, responsible persons explained.
excerpt: The regulatory path from São Paulo to a European salon shelf, explained step by step for importers.
author: BBI Editorial
content:
The Regulatory Reality

Importing cosmetics into the EU is not complicated. But it requires doing the right things in the right order — and most first-time importers from Brazil get tripped up by the same three steps.

Step 1: Appoint a Responsible Person

Every cosmetic product sold in the EU must have a Responsible Person (RP) established in the EU or UK. This is the legal entity accountable for compliance. It can be you (as the importer), a third-party compliance company, or your EU-based distributor. Without an RP, your products cannot legally be sold.

Step 2: CPNP Notification

The Cosmetic Products Notification Portal (CPNP) is the EU's centralised notification system. Every product needs a notification before it goes on sale. You'll need the product's formulation, a Certificate of Analysis, a Product Safety Report (PSR) prepared by a qualified safety assessor, and a Product Information File (PIF).

Timeline: typically 4–8 weeks from submission to approval if documentation is complete.

Step 3: Labelling Compliance

EU labelling rules require: list of ingredients in INCI nomenclature, nominal content in metric units, date of minimum durability, conditions for use, batch number, country of origin, and the RP's name and address. Portuguese-language labels must be supplemented with the local language of the country of sale.

Working With an Established Distributor

The fastest route to EU market for Brazilian brands is partnering with a distributor who already has the compliance infrastructure in place. Responsible Person status, CPNP notifications and warehouse logistics come as part of the deal — you focus on the product, they handle the paperwork.
